'''Steel alloy''' is the [[alloy]] for [[Steel equipment|steel equipment]], blasted from [[Carbon-Rich Iron|carbon-rich iron]] in {{Value|Steel Alloy|cook_time|station=Blast Furnace}}. It also crafts iron utility blocks, the [[Smithing Table|smithing table]] and the [[Smithing Upgrade Template|smithing upgrade template]].
